title: 3 magnetic bottle openers
text: 3 magnetic bottle openers. These don't last forever and so these are replacements that have been dropped and lost their magnets.  They are a brittle black plastic and metal tips, one sharp pointed they other rounded for bottle opening.  You get 3.  At our house they last about 3 or 4 years.  Work as they should and I think they are a reasonable price.
